summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: technical compliance is 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow with permission or collector errors; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only and includes $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable; fleet-doctor and operations sweeps are unavailable; material security controls remain unevidenced. Exact decision: maintain private and parked gates, permit only bounded read-only evidence and existing reversible work, and make no unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claims. Human counsel is required for rights-dependent data use, public display, alerts, affiliate or advertising expansion, privacy jurisdiction treatment, and unresolved vendor or incident obligations.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task closes because the stated deliverables are incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. The API documentation proves access mechanics but not rights to fetch, store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; public terms restrict relevant collection and derivative uses. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted uses, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. The stated purpose and operational processing are understandable, but inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table, including Slack delivery and access/session identifiers.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Measurement-only use after an explicit analytics choice is conditionally described, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking, remarketing, or customer matching.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Operational use is stated, but log fields, retention, access controls, deletion/request handling, vendor terms or DPA coverage, breach response, subpoena handling, and data-subject request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory and route unresolved legal gaps to human counsel.

Parked scaffold launch decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. The next evidence action is a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker.
